credentials.description: AI Gateway API key, sent as a bearer token. Used unless an API key is passed in settings.
Vercel OIDC token, used when no API key is configured. Read for each request so refreshed tokens are picked up.

notes: One provider for hundreds of models from many vendors through the Vercel AI Gateway: text, embeddings, images, video, speech, transcription, reranking, decisions, realtime and batches. It adds routing and fallback controls, Gateway-executed search tools and account APIs for credits and spend. Includes native Extraction V4 and continuous Realtime Live alongside the turn-based route.
